references.observed: Approximate footprint and store identity; retained extract church-gardens route-osm.json.

Full panorama pixels inspected including 2400px wide viewport. Nine tall projecting upper bays on high block, lower wing with four tall arched windows. Rounded ground glazing and entrance doors; upper spandrel panels and stepped brick corbels. White canopy diamond truss, curved knees with circles, black-footed tapered iron columns, glazing bars. Orange Sainsburys signs and readable information boards.
Full pixels inspected: plain rear side brick wall with shallow framed lower bays, grey service doors, tall window, large vent grille and white entrance hood beside church hall.

Full pixels inspected: long rear wall, high orange sign, two loading shutters with metal hood at left, taller access upstand and plain rear bays with vent grilles. Car-park wall/trolleys not part of building asset.

Satellite pixels inspected: broad pale flat rear store roof, irregular plant/ducts, two dark pitched roofs behind stepped street frontage. Main roof footprint and relationship to church hall confirmed.

uncertainties: All heights and small projections visually estimated, not survey measurements.
Simplified rectangular store footprint approximates mapped skew; base aligned to same site datum as neighbouring church.
Roof plant envelopes/positions and concealed party elevation are estimates; no claim of mechanical layout fidelity.
No interiors, product displays or unreadable notices invented; glazing is a tinted opaque exterior approximation.
